answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for learning shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s *Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work***, **Awake Academy’s *Embracing the Shadow* with Charlie Morley**, and **ManTalks’ *Shadow Course***.[3][6][19][20] For a more practice-oriented or beginner-friendly route, several Udemy and Insight Timer courses also cover shadow integration, meditation, and spiritual growth.[2][10][14][15][16][18]

A practical way to choose is:

| Course | Best for | What stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** (Jung Platform) | People who want a **Jungian / depth psychology** foundation | It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[6][13] |
| **Embracing The Shadow** (Awake Academy / Charlie Morley) | People seeking a **transformative spiritual approach** | The course is presented as highly transformative by a participant testimonial and is centered on shadow work in an academy setting.[20] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** (ManTalks) | Learners who want a structured **guided process** | It offers an immersive **8-week guided process** for facing and integrating the shadow.[19] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** (Udemy) | Budget-conscious beginners | It emphasizes healing, integration, hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[2] |
| **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth** (Insight Timer) | People who already use **meditation apps** | It is framed around healing and growth through shadow work.[10] |
| **Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing** (Insight Timer) | Learners wanting an **inner-healing** focus | It explicitly links shadow work with integration of self across mind, body, heart, and spirit.[18] |

A few observations from the results:

- **Jung Platform** looks like the most academically grounded option if you want a serious introduction to the concept.[6][13]
- **Awake Academy** appears more explicitly spiritual and experiential, especially if you already know Charlie Morley’s work.[20]
- **ManTalks** seems best if you want a longer guided container rather than a single lecture-style course.[19]
- **Udemy** offers the most variety and likely the lowest-cost entry point, but quality can vary by instructor and course.[2][14][15][16]
- **Insight Timer** is useful if you want shadow work combined with meditation and reflective practices rather than a psychology-heavy curriculum.[10][18]

If you want the shortest recommendation list:

- **Best overall for depth:** Jung Platform’s *Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work*.[6][13]
- **Best spiritual/transformational option:** Awake Academy’s *Embracing the Shadow*.[20]
- **Best guided beginner program:** ManTalks’ *Shadow Course*.[19]
- **Best low-cost starter:** Udemy’s *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self*.[2]

If you want, I can also rank these by **price, depth, spirituality, and beginner-friendliness**.
